articles.title: Structural basis of the gating mechanism of the large-conductance mechanosensitive channel from Escherichia coli
articles.abstract: Abstract The mechanosensitive channel of large conductance (MscL) is a tension-gated, pore-forming protein that acts as a safety valve to protect bacteria from osmotic lysis. Escherichia coli MscL (EcMscL) was the first mechanosensitive channel discovered and subsequently served as a model system for understanding mechanical sensing, becoming one of the most decorated and well-studied systems. Despite extensive biophysical and functional characterisation spanning several decades, the precise mechanism of EcMscL gating has been poorly understood due to the lack of high-resolution structural information. Herein, we solve two EcMscL structures by cryoEM in the closed conformation in DMPC and DOPC lipid nanodiscs. Using PELDOR/DEER spectroscopy, we screen conditions and identify that in DSPC lipids, the EcMscL conformational ensemble shifts away from the closed state and that open-like states are present. We solve the structure in an expanded state by cryoEM, revealing an architecture with pore properties consistent with previous electrophysiology reports. By combining hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry and molecular dynamics simulations, we investigate the dynamics of EcMscL gating in lipid bilayers, identifying sites involved in the closed-to-expanded transition. Combined, this enables us to inform on the elusive structural mechanism of EcMscL mechanosensitive channel function.
articles.title_zh: 大肠杆菌大电导机械敏感通道门控机制的结构基础
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 大电导机械敏感通道 (MscL) 是一种张力门控、成孔蛋白，可充当安全阀，保护细菌免遭渗透裂解。大肠杆菌 MscL (EcMscL) 是第一个被发现的机械敏感通道，随后作为理解机械传感的模型系统，成为装饰最多和研究最多的系统之一。尽管几十年来对 EcMscL 门控的精确机制进行了广泛的生物物理和功能表征，但由于缺乏高分辨率的结构信息，人们对 EcMscL 门控的精确机制知之甚少。在此，我们通过冷冻电镜解析了 DMPC 和 DOPC 脂质纳米盘中闭合构象的两个 EcMscL 结构。使用 PELDOR/DEER 光谱，我们筛选条件并确定在 DSPC 脂质中，EcMscL 构象整体偏离闭合状态，并且存在类开放状态。我们通过冷冻电镜解析了膨胀状态的结构，揭示了一种具有与之前的电生理学报告一致的孔隙特性的结构。通过结合氢-氘交换质谱和分子动力学模拟，我们研究了脂质双层中 EcMscL 门控的动力学，识别了参与闭合到扩展转变的位点。结合起来，这使我们能够了解 EcMscL 机械敏感通道功能的难以捉摸的结构机制。

articles.title: Sex of central neurons controls intestinal niche signalling to drive sex differences in stem cell activity and cancer susceptibility
articles.abstract: Abstract Sex differences in cancers arising in non-reproductive organs are widespread. While sex hormones and the intrinsic sexual identity of cancer cells are well-established contributors, it is unknown whether other mechanisms are involved. Here, we reveal an unexpected source of sex-biased cancer vulnerability in a Drosophila model of tumorigenesis. By combining genetically induced tumours with tissue- and cell type-specific sex reversals, we show that sex differences in oncogenesis can arise independently of both gonadal hormone signalling and the sexual identity of tumour cells themselves. Unexpectedly, we find that a sexually dimorphic neuronal circuit, classically associated with mating behaviour, is both necessary and sufficient to drive sex-biased intestinal tumorigenesis. The sex of these gut-innervating neurons controls tumour growth by stimulating local production of an insulin-like growth factor in the visceral muscles, a key component of the intestinal stem cell niche. Our findings reveal a previously unrecognised class of tumour-promoting input: the sex of central neurons can reprogram peripheral tumour-supportive environments. Under physiological conditions, this brain–gut pathway also modulates stem cell activity and organ size in a sex-specific manner to promote reproduction. Our work opens a new line of inquiry into how neuronal sex, particularly within the brain–gut axis, shapes physiology and disease, a field still predominantly studied in a male-only context.
articles.title_zh: 中枢神经元的性别控制肠道生态位信号传导，从而驱动干细胞活性和癌症易感性的性别差异
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 非生殖器官中发生的癌症存在广泛的性别差异。虽然性激素和癌细胞的内在性别特征是公认的贡献者，但尚不清楚是否涉及其他机制。在这里，我们揭示了果蝇肿瘤发生模型中性别偏见癌症脆弱性的一个意想不到的来源。通过将遗传诱导的肿瘤与组织和细胞类型特异性的性别逆转相结合，我们发现肿瘤发生中的性别差异可以独立于性腺激素信号传导和肿瘤细胞本身的性别身份而产生。出乎意料的是，我们发现，传统上与​​交配行为相关的性别二态性神经元回路对于驱动性别偏向性肠道肿瘤的发生是必要且充分的。这些肠道支配神经元的性别通过刺激内脏肌肉中胰岛素样生长因子的局部产生来控制肿瘤的生长，内脏肌肉是肠道干细胞生态位的关键组成部分。我们的研究结果揭示了一类以前未被认识的促肿瘤输入：中枢神经元的性别可以重新编程外周肿瘤支持环境。在生理条件下，这种脑肠通路还以性别特异性方式调节干细胞活性和器官大小，以促进生殖。我们的工作开辟了一条新的研究路线，探索神经元性别（尤其是脑肠轴内的神经元性别）如何塑造生理学和疾病，这一领域仍然主要在男性背景下进行研究。

articles.title: XPO1-mediated TRIM21 nuclear export reprograms TREM2+ macrophage polarization by targeting IRF3 to augment anti-PD-1 efficacy in small cell lung cancer
articles.abstract: Abstract Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an aggressive malignancy that responds poorly to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy, due to its immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. Here, we analyse preclinical mouse tumor models and patient-derived SCLC samples and identify Exportin 1 (XPO1) as a regulator of immune suppression in SCLC. Mechanistically, XPO1 drives the nuclear export of TRIM21, enabling TRIM21-dependent proteasomal degradation of IRF3 and repressing the immunostimulatory cytokine TNFSF15. Loss of TNFSF15 promotes TREM2 + macrophage polarization, which subsequently attenuates macrophage-dependent IFN-γ-STAT1 signaling and MHC class I expression in tumor cells. Pharmacological or genetic XPO1 blockade restores TNFSF15, constrains TREM2 + macrophage differentiation, reactivates antigen presentation, and enhances anti-PD-1 efficacy in preclinical mouse models. Thus, our findings link XPO1-dependent nuclear export to TREM2+ macrophage polarization and support evaluation of XPO1 inhibition in combination with ICIs in SCLC.
articles.title_zh: XPO1介导的TRIM21核输出通过靶向IRF3重新编程TREM2+巨噬细胞极化以增强小细胞肺癌中的抗PD-1功效
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要：小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种侵袭性恶性肿瘤，由于其免疫抑制的肿瘤微环境，对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗反应不佳。在这里，我们分析了临床前小鼠肿瘤模型和患者来源的 SCLC 样本，并确定 Exportin 1 (XPO1) 作为 SCLC 免疫抑制的调节剂。从机制上讲，XPO1 驱动 TRIM21 的核输出，从而实现 TRIM21 依赖性的 IRF3 蛋白酶体降解并抑制免疫刺激细胞因子 TNFSF15。 TNFSF15 的缺失会促进 TREM2 + 巨噬细胞极化，从而减弱肿瘤细胞中巨噬细胞依赖性 IFN-γ-STAT1 信号传导和 MHC I 类表达。药理学或基因 XPO1 阻断可恢复 TNFSF15，限制 TREM2 + 巨噬细胞分化，重新激活抗原呈递，并增强临床前小鼠模型中的抗 PD-1 功效。因此，我们的研究结果将 XPO1 依赖性核输出与 TREM2+ 巨噬细胞极化联系起来，并支持在 SCLC 中结合 ICI 评估 XPO1 抑制作用。

articles.title: Identification of a spatially organized TREM2-associated permissive macrophage niche in human pulmonary tuberculosis alveolar pneumonia
articles.abstract: Abstract Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB), caused by lung infection with Mycobacterium tuberculosis ( Mtb ), often manifests both alveolar pneumonia and aggregation of immune cells containing Mtb , termed granulomas, within the same lung. Here, we integrate spatial transcriptomics, single-cell RNA sequencing, high-resolution imaging, and functional assays of lung biopsies from four men with pulmonary TB to compare alveolar pneumonia with adjacent granulomas. We find that alveolar TB pneumonia is enriched for TREM2⁺ lipid-laden macrophages characterized by increased lipid metabolism gene expression, reduced T cell infiltration, attenuated antimicrobial gene expression, and abundant Mtb transcripts and antigens. By contrast, neighboring granulomas exhibit organized lymphoid architecture and robust antimicrobial programs. In vitro, Mtb lipids induce TREM2 expression, activate TREM2–DAP12 signaling, and promote lipid droplet accumulation in primary human monocyte-derived macrophages (MDM). Furthermore, TREM2 + MDMs are more susceptible to in vitro Mtb infection. When treating MDMs with 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D₃, which induces antimicrobial macrophage programs, TREM2 + MDM numbers, lipid droplet abundance and Mtb viability are decreased. Thus, we propose a spatially localized, alveolar pneumonia-intrinsic TREM2⁺ macrophage program that potentially contributes to Mtb persistence in pulmonary TB infection in humans.
articles.title_zh: 人肺结核肺泡性肺炎中空间组织的 TREM2 相关巨噬细胞生态位的鉴定
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 肺结核（TB）是由结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）肺部感染引起的，通常表现为肺泡性肺炎和含有Mtb的免疫细胞在同一肺内聚集，称为肉芽肿。在这里，我们整合了四名肺结核患者肺活检的空间转录组学、单细胞 RNA 测序、高分辨率成像和功能分析，以比较肺泡肺炎与邻近肉芽肿。我们发现肺泡结核肺炎富含 TREM2⁺ 载脂巨噬细胞，其特征是脂质代谢基因表达增加、T 细胞浸润减少、抗菌基因表达减弱以及丰富的 Mtb 转录物和抗原。相比之下，邻近的肉芽肿表现出有组织的淋巴结构和强大的抗菌程序。在体外，Mtb 脂质诱导 TREM2 表达，激活 TREM2-DAP12 信号传导，并促进原代人单核细胞源性巨噬细胞 (MDM) 中脂滴的积累。此外，TREM2 + MDMs 更容易受到体外 Mtb 感染。当用 1,25-二羟基维生素 D₃ 治疗 MDM 时，会诱导抗菌巨噬细胞程序，TREM2 + MDM 数量、脂滴丰度和 Mtb 活力都会降低。因此，我们提出了一种空间局部的、肺泡肺炎固有的 TREM2⁺ 巨噬细胞程序，该程序可能有助于人类肺结核感染中 Mtb 的持续存在。

articles.title: Suppressed excitonic effects enable high mobility and high-yield photoconductivity in a pyridine-coordinated two-dimensional polymer crystal
articles.abstract: Abstract Two-dimensional polymers (2DPs) and their layer-stacked covalent organic frameworks (2D COFs) offer modular, atomically precise platforms for organic optoelectronics, yet their photoconductive responses remain fundamentally constrained by strong excitonic effects and localized charge transport. Here, we demonstrate that a diyne-linked 2DP crystal with axial pyridine coordination overcomes this limitation, enabling simultaneous efficient free-carrier generation and band-like transport. Introducing pyridine ligands that axially coordinate to Cu–porphyrin nodes transforms weak van der Waals stacking into a pyridine-bridged architecture with pronounced interlayer band dispersion and substantially reduced carrier effective masses. The resulting strong interlayer electronic coupling suppresses the exciton binding energy to well below thermal energy, such that optical excitation directly populates delocalized electronic states. Time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy reveals Drude-type photoconductivity with room-temperature mobilities approaching 500 cm 2 ·V⁻ 1 ·s⁻ 1 and a photon-to-free-carrier conversion ratio of ~0.4. These results establish interlayer coordination as a powerful strategy for mitigating excitonic effects and accessing inorganic-like charge transport in organic 2D crystals, opening a pathway toward highly efficient photo-to-electricity conversion in organic-based systems.
articles.title_zh: 抑制激子效应可在吡啶配位的二维聚合物晶体中实现高迁移率和高产光电导性
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 二维聚合物（2DP）及其层状堆叠共价有机框架（2D COF）为有机光电子学提供了模块化、原子级精确的平台，但它们的光电导响应仍然受到强激子效应和局域电荷传输的根本限制。在这里，我们证明具有轴向吡啶配位的二炔连接的 2DP 晶体克服了这一限制，从而能够同时有效地产生自由载流子和带状传输。引入与铜卟啉节点轴向配位的吡啶配体将弱范德华堆积转变为吡啶桥结构，具有显着的层间能带色散和显着降低的载流子有效质量。由此产生的强层间电子耦合将激子结合能抑制到远低于热能，从而光学激发直接填充离域电子态。时间分辨太赫兹光谱揭示了 Drude 型光电导，室温迁移率接近 500 cm 2 ·V⁻ 1 ·s⁻ 1 ，光子与自由载流子的转换比约为 0.4。这些结果将层间配位确立为一种强有力的策略，可减轻激子效应并在有机二维晶体中实现类似无机的电荷传输，从而为有机系统中高效光电转换开辟了道路。

articles.title: Persistent influence of the North Atlantic Oscillation on Late Holocene hydroclimate in southwestern Greenland
articles.abstract: Abstract Understanding how global climate forcing shapes regional hydroclimate on decadal to millennial timescales is critical for predicting the response of continental ice sheets to future warming. Because instrumental observations capture only a short interval, longer-term perspectives require proxy records. Here we present a high-resolution sedimentary record covering the entire Holocene from southwestern Greenland. We show that after the demise of local glaciers in the Early Holocene, the record allows evaluation of millennial to decadal variations in local precipitation. Comparison with North Atlantic Oscillation (NAO) reconstructions and climate model simulations demonstrates that positive NAO phases correspond to wetter but colder regional conditions. These findings suggest that centennial-scale patterns of ice mass balance during the late Holocene were influenced by precipitation variability, in addition to temperature changes. While the sensitivity to precipitation variability may change under a warmer climate, our results underscore the importance of integrating shifts in NAO-driven moisture delivery to accurately assess the future stability of the Greenland Ice Sheet.
articles.title_zh: 北大西洋涛动对格陵兰岛西南部全新世晚期水文气候的持续影响
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 了解全球气候强迫如何在十年到千年的时间尺度上塑造区域水文气候对于预测大陆冰盖对未来变暖的响应至关重要。由于仪器观测只能捕获较短的时间间隔，因此需要更长期的视角来替代记录。在这里，我们展示了覆盖格陵兰岛西南部整个全新世的高分辨率沉积记录。我们表明，在全新世早期当地冰川消亡后，记录可以评估当地降水的千年到十年的变化。与北大西洋涛动 (NAO) 重建和气候模型模拟的比较表明，正 NAO 阶段对应于更潮湿但更寒冷的区域条件。这些发现表明，除了温度变化之外，全新世晚期冰质量平衡的百年尺度模式还受到降水变化的影响。虽然在气候变暖的情况下对降水变化的敏感性可能会发生变化，但我们的结果强调了整合 NAO 驱动的水分输送变化以准确评估格陵兰冰盖未来稳定性的重要性。

articles.title: Vorticity-induced short-range ordering for heat insulation in anisotropically bonded CsAg2I3
articles.abstract: Abstract Vortical motion naturally occurs on various scales, from galaxies to skyrmions, influencing the dynamics of mass and information transport. Yet its impact on lattice dynamics in solids is rarely explored so far, primarily owing to the strong interatomic bonds in real materials that inhibit the actual transport of their constituent species. Here we investigate the effect of vortical modes of polarized phonons on the heat insulation of solid materials using synchrotron X-ray diffuse scattering and inelastic neutron scattering along with ab initio molecular dynamics simulations. We demonstrate this vortical vibration as well as its effect on thermal insulation in CsAg 2 I 3 , where the anisotropically bonded iodine atoms form the low-lying transverse optical phonons for enhancing scattering phase space. Moreover, the vortical modes, mainly arising from the chiral symmetric operations acting on the iodine sites, induce two-dimensional short-range-ordering of atomic clusters, lead to a substantially increased phonon scattering centers with a diameter on the order of ~2 primitive cells. This eventually results in extraordinary heat insulation in the single-crystalline CsAg 2 I 3 , exhibiting a thermal conductivity as low as 0.08 W/m-K at room temperature. This strategy establishes a material design paradigm for heat insulation and unveils an unexplored avenue for phonon transport manipulation.
articles.title_zh: 各向异性键合 CsAg2I3 中隔热的涡量诱导短程有序化
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 涡旋运动自然发生在从星系到斯格明子的各种尺度上，影响质量和信息传输的动力学。然而，迄今为止，它对固体晶格动力学的影响很少被探讨，这主要是由于真实材料中强大的原子间键抑制了其组成物质的实际传输。在这里，我们使用同步加速器 X 射线漫散射和非弹性中子散射以及从头算分子动力学模拟来研究偏振声子涡旋模式对固体材料隔热的影响。我们证明了这种涡旋振动及其对 CsAg 2 I 3 隔热的影响，其中各向异性键合的碘原子形成低位横向光学声子，以增强散射相空间。此外，主要由作用于碘位点的手性对称操作产生的涡旋模式引起原子团簇的二维短程排序，导致声子散射中心显着增加，其直径约为2个原始细胞的数量级。这最终导致单晶 CsAg 2 I 3 具有非凡的隔热性能，在室温下表现出低至 0.08 W/m-K 的导热率。该策略建立了隔热材料设计范例，并为声子传输操纵开辟了一条未经探索的途径。

articles.title:
Microplastics as
Selective Substrates for Marine Microorganisms:
Beyond the Toxicological Paradigm
articles.abstract: Abstract Microplastics (MPs) are widely studied as marine contaminants, yet their ecological roles in microbial systems remain incompletely understood. Conventional toxicological frameworks, largely developed for multicellular organisms, emphasize acute stress and cellular damage but capture only a limited subset of microbial responses. Here, we propose a stage-structured framework in which MPs function primarily as selective substrates rather than as conventional toxicants. Plastisphere assembly is governed by dynamically shifting selection across three stages: initial physicochemical filtering, substrate- and metabolism-driven selection, and biofilm-mediated spatial adaptation. Central to this process is the coupling between substrate transformation and reactive oxygen species (ROS) dynamics. Extracellular ROS arise from interfacial reactions of weathered plastic compounds, while intracellular ROS are generated during microbial carbon assimilation. These processes are mechanistically linked: plastic-derived compounds act as both substrates and stressors, and extracellular ROS further transform them into more bioavailable forms, reinforcing intracellular constraints. Biofilms introduce spatial organization that redistributes metabolic and oxidative burdens, enabling metabolic cooperation, stress partitioning, and HGT, allowing selection to operate at both individual traits and spatially organized community levels. Together, this framework shifts the perspective from toxicity-based interpretations toward a selection paradigm that integrates substrate availability, metabolic constraints, and spatial organization, providing a mechanistic basis for linking microscale microbial processes to broader ecological and biogeochemical dynamics.
articles.title_zh:
微塑料作为
海洋微生物的选择性底物：
超越毒理学范式
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 微塑料（MP）作为海洋污染物被广泛研究，但它们在微生物系统中的生态作用仍不完全清楚。传统的毒理学框架主要是为多细胞生物开发的，强调急性应激和细胞损伤，但仅捕获微生物反应的有限子集。在这里，我们提出了一个阶段结构的框架，其中 MP 主要作为选择性底物而不是传统的毒物。塑料球组装由三个阶段的动态转移选择控制：初始物理化学过滤、底物和代谢驱动的选择以及生物膜介导的空间适应。该过程的核心是底物转化和活性氧 (ROS) 动力学之间的耦合。细胞外活性氧是由风化塑料化合物的界面反应产生的，而细胞内活性氧是在微生物碳同化过程中产生的。这些过程在机械上是相互关联的：塑料衍生的化合物既充当底物又充当应激源，细胞外活性氧进一步将它们转化为更具生物可利用性的形式，从而强化了细胞内的限制。生物膜引入了重新分配代谢和氧化负担的空间组织，从而实现代谢合作、压力分配和HGT，从而允许选择在个体性状和空间组织的群落水平上进行。总之，该框架将视角从基于毒性的解释转向整合了底物可用性、代谢限制和空间组织的选择范式，为将微观微生物过程与更广泛的生态和生物地球化学动力学联系起来提供了机制基础。

articles.title:
Deriving Antibiotic
Thresholds Under a One Health
Framework: Integrating Bioaccumulation and Human Exposure in the Yangtze
River Estuary Food Web
articles.abstract: Abstract Antibiotics are widely detected in aquatic environments, yet current environmental thresholds rarely integrate ecological and human health risks under a One Health framework. Here, we developed a bioaccumulation- and human exposure-based approach to derive health-protective environmental thresholds for antibiotics in the Yangtze River Estuary (YRE). Total antibiotic concentrations averaged 6.64 ± 5.91 ng/L in water, 9.65 ± 7.55 ng/g in sediment, and 56.4 ± 80.9 ng/g in aquatic organisms, with significant cross-compartmental variability and distinct compositional patterns among environmental matrices. Chloramphenicol (CAP) exhibited the strongest bioaccumulation potential (BCF up to 20,190 L/g) and was the only compound showing trophic magnification (TMF = 2.97), whereas most other antibiotics displayed trophic dilution. Derived thresholds ranged from 2.04 × 10–5–434 ng/L for water and 3.01 × 10–4–17.0 ng/g for sediment, several orders of magnitude lower than thresholds derived using traditional ecotoxicity-based approaches in previous studies. CAP, norfloxacin, and ofloxacin were identified as priority risk compounds, demonstrating that even moderate environmental concentrations can bioaccumulate through aquatic food webs and pose notable dietary exposure risks to consumers. This framework provides a more protective basis for antibiotic pollution management and environmental standard development under a One Health perspective.
articles.title_zh:
衍生抗生素
单一健康的阈值
框架：整合长江生物累积和人类暴露
河口食物网
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 抗生素在水生环境中广泛检测到，但目前的环境阈值很少将生态和人类健康风险整合到“同一个健康”框架下。在这里，我们开发了一种基于生物蓄积和人体暴露的方法，以得出长江口 (YRE) 抗生素的健康保护环境阈值。水中的抗生素总浓度平均为 6.64 ± 5.91 ng/L，沉积物中为 9.65 ± 7.55 ng/g，水生生物中为 56.4 ± 80.9 ng/g，具有显着的跨区室变异性和环境基质中不同的组成模式。氯霉素 (CAP) 表现出最强的生物蓄积潜力（BCF 高达 20,190 L/g），并且是唯一表现出营养放大作用的化合物（TMF = 2.97），而大多数其他抗生素表现出营养稀释。得出的水阈值范围为 2.04 × 10–5–434 ng/L，沉积物阈值范围为 3.01 × 10–4–17.0 ng/g，比之前研究中使用传统的基于生态毒性的方法得出的阈值低几个数量级。 CAP、诺氟沙星和氧氟沙星被确定为优先风险化合物，表明即使是中等浓度的环境浓度也可以通过水生食物网进行生物累积，并对消费者构成显着的饮食暴露风险。该框架为“同一个健康”视角下的抗生素污染管理和环境标准制定提供了更具保护性的基础。

articles.title:
Transformation of
Dissolved Organic Matter by Aqueous
Fe(IV) under Acidic Conditions: Bulk-to-Molecular Insights into Reaction
Kinetics and Mechanisms
articles.abstract: Abstract Aqueous Fe(IV) has emerged as a significant nonradical oxidant in iron-based oxidative water treatment, yet its reaction kinetics and mechanisms with dissolved organic matter (DOM) remain largely unexplored. Herein, second-order rate constants (k) for Fe(IV) reactions with DOM and DOM-relevant model compounds were determined under acidic conditions using a competition kinetics method performed on self-assembled quenched-flow apparatuses. At pH 3.0, k for 15 DOM isolates ranged from (2.1 ± 0.2) × 104 MC–1 s–1 to (11.6 ± 0.9) × 104 MC–1 s–1 and correlated strongly with the electron-donating capacity of DOM. Similarly, k for nine para-substituted phenolic compounds correlated linearly with the Hammett constant σ+, EHOMO, and vertical ionization potential, supporting Fe(IV) selectivity toward electron-rich substrates. Across pH 1.0–3.5, k for DOM increased monotonically from the 104 to 105 MC–1 s–1 scale. In contrast, k for 11 model compounds representing major DOM moieties spanned 101–107 M–1 s–1 and exhibited moiety-specific pH dependences, indicating that individual DOM components contribute differently to overall Fe(IV)-DOM reactivity. Fluorescence spectroscopy revealed broad-spectrum oxidation of DOM fluorophores, whereas high-resolution mass spectrometry showed that Fe(IV) preferentially transformed unsaturated moieties, oxidized nitrogen/sulfur-containing functionalities, and fragmented moderate-molecular-weight molecules. These findings provide a bulk-to-molecular kinetic and mechanistic basis for predicting Fe(IV) fate in DOM-containing waters and optimizing Fe(IV)-based advanced oxidation processes.
articles.title_zh:
改造
水溶解有机物
酸性条件下的 Fe(IV)：从整体到分子的反应洞察
动力学和机制
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 水相 Fe(IV) 已成为铁基氧化水处理中重要的非自由基氧化剂，但其与溶解有机物 (DOM) 的反应动力学和机制仍有待探索。在此，使用在自组装骤冷流装置上进行的竞争动力学方法，在酸性条件下测定了 Fe(IV) 与 DOM 和 DOM 相关模型化合物反应的二阶速率常数 (k)。在 pH 3.0 时，15 个 DOM 分离株的 k 范围为 (2.1 ± 0.2) × 104 MC–1 s–1 至 (11.6 ± 0.9) × 104 MC–1 s–1，并且与 DOM 的供电子能力密切相关。同样，九种对位取代酚类化合物的 k 与哈米特常数 σ+、EHOMO 和垂直电离势线性相关，支持 Fe(IV) 对富电子底物的选择性。在 pH 1.0–3.5 范围内，DOM 的 k 从 104 MC–1 s–1 范围单调增加至 105 MC–1 s–1。相比之下，代表主要 DOM 部分的 11 种模型化合物的 k 跨度为 101–107 M–1 s–1，并表现出特定于部分的 pH 依赖性，表明各个 DOM 组分对总体 Fe(IV)-DOM 反应性的贡献不同。荧光光谱显示 DOM 荧光团的广谱氧化，而高分辨率质谱显示 Fe(IV) 优先转化不饱和部分、氧化的含氮/硫官能团和破碎的中等分子量分子。这些发现为预测含 DOM 的水中 Fe(IV) 的命运和优化基于 Fe(IV) 的高级氧化过程提供了本体到分子动力学和机理基础。

articles.title:
Nontarget
Analysis of the Volatile and Semivolatile
Chemical Profile of Wildland Firefighter Gear: Insight into Occupational
Exposure and Health Implications
articles.abstract: Abstract Prescribed fire releases a complex mixture of volatile and semivolatile organic compounds to the environment. Firefighters are directly exposed to these hazardous mixtures through occupational activities. This study investigated the volatile and semivolatile chemical contamination profile of firefighter protective gear and the effectiveness of laundering as a decontamination strategy. Our results revealed that firefighter gear accumulated a broad spectrum of combustion-derived contaminants, predominantly composed of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and derivatives, phenolic compounds, and aromatic hydrocarbons. Representative compounds identified included toluene, biphenyl, naphthalene, 1-methynaphthalene, 2-methylnaphthalene, acenaphthene, phenol, alkylated phenols, and chlorinated phenols. Quantitative analysis revealed representative combustion-derived compounds at concentrations (mean ± standard deviation, SD) including toluene (0.958 ± 0.293 ng/g), biphenyl (0.015 ± 0.004 ng/g), naphthalene (0.053 ± 0.020 ng/g), 1-methynaphthalene (0.468 ± 0.132 ng/g), 2-methylnaphthalene (0.009 ± 0.002 ng/g), and acenaphthene (0.303 ± 0.001 ng/g). Multivariate analysis showed that although laundering substantially reduced contaminant levels, residues of several compounds remained significantly detectable in washed samples. These results demonstrate that firefighter personal protective equipment (PPE) serves as a reservoir for toxic compounds, underscoring the additional risk of secondary exposure to firefighters through dermal contact, handling, and off-gassing. Together, our findings emphasize the need for the safe transport of protective gear (e.g., in sealed bags), proper storage before laundering, and periodic replacement of these protective materials. This will help mitigate secondary exposure and adverse long-term health effects.
articles.title_zh:
非目标
挥发性和半挥发性物质的分析
荒地消防员装备的化学成分：职业洞察
接触和健康影响
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 规定的火灾会向环境中释放挥发性和半挥发性有机化合物的复杂混合物。消防员通过职业活动直接接触这些危险混合物。本研究调查了消防员防护装备的挥发性和半挥发性化学污染状况以及洗涤作为净化策略的有效性。我们的结果显示，消防员装备积累了多种燃烧产生的污染物，主要由多环芳烃及其衍生物、酚类化合物和芳烃组成。鉴定出的代表性化合物包括甲苯、联苯、萘、1-甲基萘、2-甲基萘、苊、苯酚、烷基化苯酚和氯化苯酚。定量分析显示，代表性燃烧衍生化合物的浓度（平均值±标准差，SD）包括甲苯（0.958±0.293ng/g）、联苯（0.015±0.004ng/g）、萘（0.053±0.020ng/g）、1-甲基萘（0.468±0.132ng/g）、 2-甲基萘 (0.009 ± 0.002 ng/g) 和苊 (0.303 ± 0.001 ng/g)。多变量分析表明，尽管清洗大大降低了污染物水平，但在清洗后的样品中仍可明显检测到多种化合物的残留物。这些结果表明，消防员个人防护装备 (PPE) 是有毒化合物的储存库，强调了消防员通过皮肤接触、操作和排气而二次接触的额外风险。总之，我们的研究结果强调了安全运输防护装备（例如，在密封袋中）、洗涤前适当储存以及定期更换这些防护材料的必要性。这将有助于减轻二次暴露和长期不利的健康影响。

articles.title:
Carbonyl
and Fouling
Indices as Screening Descriptors
for Ecotoxicological Responses to Aged Microplastics
articles.abstract: Abstract Microplastics (MPs) inevitably undergo aging processes in the environment, which alter their physicochemical properties and may modify their ecological effects. To synthesize the current evidence on aged-MP ecotoxicity, we conducted a meta-analysis of 54 studies comprising 1400 observations across animals, microalgae, and plants. Compared with pristine MPs, aged MPs were generally associated with reduced locomotion and neurological performance in aquatic and terrestrial animals, suppressed microalgal growth, and apparent stimulation of some plant growth-related end points. These divergent responses were associated with aging-related descriptors, particularly the carbonyl index (CI) and fouling index (FI), although their relevance varied across taxa, end points, polymers, and exposure contexts. The CI was negatively associated with animal locomotor responses, while the FI was more closely related to physiology-related responses in the primary producers. Targeted validation experiments using polystyrene (PS) and polyvinyl chloride (PVC) further showed that an increased CI was accompanied by reduced zebrafish locomotion and elevated ROS levels, whereas FI-associated algal responses were accompanied by oxidative stress. Overall, the CI and FI can help compare aged-MP effects across studies and support more generalized and more realistic assessments of aged-MP ecotoxicity. However, these descriptors remain simplified indicators and cannot fully capture the complexity of actual environmental systems, including mixed aging processes, leachate chemistry, multistressor exposure, and matrix-specific interactions.
articles.title_zh:
羰基
和污垢
作为筛选描述符的指数
对老化微塑料的生态毒理学反应
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 微塑料（MP）在环境中不可避免地会经历老化过程，从而改变其物理化学性质并可能改变其生态效应。为了综合有关老化 MP 生态毒性的现有证据，我们对 54 项研究进行了荟萃分析，其中包括动物、微藻和植物的 1400 项观察结果。与原始 MP 相比，老化 MP 通常与水生和陆生动物的运动和神经功能降低、微藻生长受到抑制以及某些植物生长相关终点的明显刺激有关。这些不同的反应与老化相关描述符有关，特别是羰基指数（CI）和污垢指数（FI），尽管它们的相关性因分类群、终点、聚合物和暴露环境而异。 CI 与动物运动反应呈负相关，而 FI 与初级生产者的生理相关反应更密切相关。使用聚苯乙烯 (PS) 和聚氯乙烯 (PVC) 的靶向验证实验进一步表明，CI 的增加伴随着斑马鱼运动的减少和 ROS 水平的升高，而 FI 相关的藻类反应则伴随着氧化应激。总体而言，CI 和 FI 可以帮助比较不同研究中老化 MP 的影响，并支持对老化 MP 生态毒性进行更普遍、更现实的评估。然而，这些描述符仍然是简化的指标，不能完全捕捉实际环境系统的复杂性，包括混合老化过程、渗滤液化学、多重压力源暴露和特定基质的相互作用。

articles.title:
A
Hybrid LCA Framework for Drug-Level Carbon Footprint
Assessment under Data Constraints: Application to Narrower-Spectrum
Penicillin
articles.abstract: Abstract Understanding differences in drug-specific carbon footprints across countries is increasingly important as healthcare sustainability and product-level reporting gain prominence in regulatory initiatives, such as digital product passports, yet such estimates remain largely unavailable due to sparse drug-level data. Here, we develop a hybrid life cycle assessment framework that enables quantification of drug-specific carbon footprints across regions under real-world data constraints. It combines drug-level life cycle inventory with international consumption and trade statistics and embeds a structured uncertainty assessment to evaluate key data gaps and modeling choices through robustness tests. We demonstrate its application using narrower-spectrum penicillin. We estimate that its global consumption in 2019 was associated with about 90 kt CO2e. Although modest in magnitude, the footprint’s geographic distribution differs markedly from that of aggregated pharmaceuticals, showing that sector-level accounting can mask substantial cross-country heterogeneity. Across alternative assumptions, global totals vary by less than 30%, and country rankings remain largely stable, indicating that the observed patterns reflect structural differences in consumption and sourcing rather than artifacts of specific modeling choices. This framework offers a transparent pathway for drug-level carbon accounting under data scarcity and identifies data and methodological priorities to support future reporting, procurement, and decarbonization efforts in the pharmaceutical sector.
articles.title_zh:
一个
药物级碳足迹的混合 LCA 框架
数据约束下的评估：应用于窄谱
青霉素
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 随着医疗保健可持续性和产品级报告在数字产品护照等监管举措中占据重要地位，了解各国特定药物碳足迹的差异变得越来越重要，但由于药物级数据稀疏，此类估计仍然基本上无法获得。在这里，我们开发了一个混合生命周期评估框架，可以在现实世界数据限制下量化跨地区的药物特定碳足迹。它将药品生命周期清单与国际消费和贸易统计相结合，并嵌入结构化不确定性评估，以通过稳健性测试评估关键数据差距和建模选择。我们使用窄谱青霉素演示了其应用。我们估计 2019 年其全球消耗量约为 90 kt CO2e。尽管规模不大，但足迹的地理分布与聚合药品的地理分布明显不同，这表明行业层面的核算可以掩盖巨大的跨国异质性。在不同的假设中，全球总数的差异不到 30%，国家排名基本保持稳定，这表明观察到的模式反映了消费和采购的结构性差异，而不是特定模型选择的产物。该框架为数据稀缺情况下的药品级碳核算提供了一条透明的途径，并确定了数据和方法优先事项，以支持制药行业未来的报告、采购和脱碳工作。

articles.title: Chlorine Radical Cycling Amplifies Photolytic NO x Release
articles.abstract: Abstract The atmospheric chlorine radical (Cl•) is a highly reactive oxidant. However, its formation on particulate matter (PM) surfaces and its role in nitrogen chemistry remain insufficiently understood. This study investigated the Cl• chemistry on photoactive PM and evaluated its potential influence on atmospheric nitrogen cycling. Experimental evidence confirms that the chloride ion (Cl–) on the photoactive surface undergoes oxidation by photogenerated hole (h+) to form Cl•, which subsequently accelerates nitrite intermediate conversion to gaseous nitrogen oxides (NOx). Under the model experimental conditions, this process enhanced NOx formation by approximately 40-fold, while Cl– was regenerated during the reaction. Additional experiments with different chloride salts and acidity controls indicate that the enhancement is mainly associated with Cl–-involved photochemistry. This mechanism maintains efficacy across various humidity conditions and can be extended to diverse photoreactive PM (e.g., soot) and different nitrogen-containing components (e.g., ammonium, 4-nitrophenol). Experiments with reduced photoactive matter loadings and simulated atmospheric PM further reveal that the reaction rate is regulated by PM composition and the abundance of photoactive matter. Environmental simulations suggest that this surface Cl• cycling process may contribute 0.7%–6.2% to NO2 variability in the study area. Overall, this study identifies a previously overlooked Cl•-mediated surface process on photoactive PM and highlights its potential contribution to tropospheric nitrogen transformations.
articles.title_zh: 氯 自由基循环放大光解NO x 发布
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 大气中的氯自由基(Cl•)是一种高活性氧化剂。然而，人们对它在颗粒物 (PM) 表面的形成及其在氮化学中的作用仍知之甚少。本研究研究了光活性PM 中的Cl• 化学性质，并评估了其对大气氮循环的潜在影响。实验证据证实，光敏表面上的氯离子（Cl–）被光生空穴（h+）氧化形成Cl•，随后加速亚硝酸盐中间体转化为气态氮氧化物（NOx）。在模型实验条件下，该过程使 NOx 的形成增加了约 40 倍，而 Cl- 在反应过程中被再生。使用不同氯化物盐和酸度控制的其他实验表明，这种增强主要与 Cl 涉及的光化学有关。这种机制在各种湿度条件下都能保持功效，并且可以扩展到不同的光反应性 PM（例如烟灰）和不同的含氮成分（例如铵、4-硝基苯酚）。减少光活性物质负载和模拟大气 PM 的实验进一步表明，反应速率受 PM 成分和光活性物质丰度的调节。环境模拟表明，这种表面Cl• 循环过程可能对研究区域的NO2 变化产生0.7%–6.2% 的影响。总体而言，这项研究确定了以前被忽视的 Cl• 介导的光活性 PM 表面过程，并强调了其对对流层氮转化的潜在贡献。

articles.title:
Depth-Resolved Metagenomics
Reveals Nitrate- and Sulfate-Mediated
Arsenic Transformation in Lake Tosen, a Stratified Saline Lake on
the Tibetan Plateau
articles.abstract: Abstract High-altitude saline lakes on the Tibetan Plateau host some of the world’s most arsenic-rich waters, yet controls on arsenic (As) transformation remain poorly resolved. By integrating depth-resolved geochemistry with metagenomic profiling in Lake Tosen, we identified a redox framework for As cycling that is not fully explained by the Fe-centric model derived from groundwater and freshwater. In summer, oxic-suboxic-anoxic stratification supported three distinct pathways: (i) oxic waters exhibited a microbial detoxification-oxidation loop sustaining As(V) dominance; (ii) suboxic waters were associated with nitrate-supported As(III) oxidation linked to denitrifying taxa; and (iii) anoxic sulfidic waters showed sulfate-reduction-related As transformation, with sulfur cycling likely modifying the fate and mobility of released As under sulfidic conditions. Meanwhile, canonical Fe(III)-respiration markers were not prominent, and saturation indices indicated stable goethite/hematite under in situ conditions. Together, these findings indicate that, under the observed stratified conditions in Lake Tosen, nitrate- and sulfate-associated pathways were more closely linked to arsenic transformation than canonical Fe(III)-respiration signals. This nonclassical coupling may become increasingly relevant as stratification, nitrate loading, and salinization intensify, with implications for As risk prediction in endorheic basins under changing climates.
articles.title_zh:
深度解析宏基因组学
揭示硝酸盐和硫酸盐介导的
东仙湖（一个分层盐湖）中的砷转化
青藏高原
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 青藏高原的高海拔盐湖拥有世界上砷含量最丰富的一些水域，但对砷（As）转化的控制仍然没有得到很好的解决。通过将深度分辨地球化学与托森湖宏基因组分析相结合，我们确定了砷循环的氧化还原框架，而源自地下水和淡水的以铁为中心的模型无法完全解释该框架。在夏季，含氧-缺氧-缺氧分层支持三种不同的途径：（i）含氧水表现出微生物解毒-氧化循环，维持As（V）的优势； (ii) 低氧水与反硝化类群相关的硝酸盐支持的 As(III) 氧化有关； (iii) 缺氧硫化水表现出与硫酸盐还原相关的砷转化，硫循环可能改变硫化物条件下释放的砷的命运和迁移率。同时，典型的 Fe(III) 呼吸标记并不突出，饱和指数表明在原位条件下存在稳定的针铁矿/赤铁矿。总之，这些发现表明，在托森湖观察到的分层条件下，硝酸盐和硫酸盐相关途径与砷转化的联系比典型的 Fe(III) 呼吸信号更密切。随着分层、硝酸盐负荷和盐化的加剧，这种非经典耦合可能变得越来越重要，并对气候变化下内流盆地的砷风险预测产生影响。

articles.title:
Chemoproteomics
Prioritizes Mitochondrial ADP/ATP
Translocase as a Candidate Target Associated with 6PPDQ-Induced Respiratory
Toxicity in Rainbow Trout Gill
articles.abstract: Abstract 6PPD quinone (6PPDQ) is an emerging contaminant that induces acute respiratory toxicity in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), yet its underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. In the present study, short-term in vivo exposure of rainbow trout to 6PPDQ resulted in substantial accumulation and limited biotransformation of 6PPDQ in the gill, accompanied by pronounced gill structural damage and increased whole-fish oxygen consumption. Taking advantage of the electrophilic reactivity of the quinone moiety of 6PPDQ toward cysteine residues, we applied activity-based protein profiling (ABPP) to gill tissue. ABPP revealed marked alterations in mitochondrial cysteine reactivity and highlighted ADP/ATP translocase (ANT) as a candidate 6PPDQ-interacting mitochondrial protein. A Cys-160-containing ANT peptide within the nucleotide-binding domain of ANT was pinpointed as the covalent binding site through ABPP, Peptide-centric Local Stability Assay (PELSA), and molecular docking. Functional assays using isolated gill mitochondria showed that 6PPDQ elicited an uncoupling-like mitochondrial respiratory response that was partially attenuated by the ANT inhibitor carboxyatractyloside (CATR), supporting the functional involvement of ANT in this gill-based model. Together, these findings nominate ANT as a candidate gill mitochondrial target associated with 6PPDQ-induced acute respiratory toxicity and demonstrate the utility of chemoproteomics for prioritizing mechanistically relevant protein interactions of emerging pollutants.
articles.title_zh:
化学蛋白质组学
优先考虑线粒体 ADP/ATP
易位酶作为与 6PPDQ 诱导呼吸相关的候选靶点
虹鳟鱼鳃的毒性
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 6PPD 醌 (6PPDQ) 是一种新兴污染物，可引起虹鳟鱼 (Oncorhynchus mykiss) 急性呼吸道毒性，但其潜在分子机制仍知之甚少。在本研究中，虹鳟鱼体内短期暴露于 6PPDQ 导致 6PPDQ 在鳃中大量积累和有限的生物转化，同时伴有明显的鳃结构损伤和全鱼耗氧量增加。利用 6PPDQ 醌部分对半胱氨酸残基的亲电子反应性，我们对鳃组织应用了基于活性的蛋白质分析 (ABPP)。 ABPP 揭示了线粒体半胱氨酸反应性的显着变化，并强调 ADP/ATP 转位酶 (ANT) 作为候选 6PPDQ 相互作用线粒体蛋白。通过 ABPP、以肽为中心的局部稳定性测定 (PELSA) 和分子对接，将 ANT 核苷酸结合域内含有 Cys-160 的 ANT 肽确定为共价结合位点。使用分离的鳃线粒体进行的功能测定表明，6PPDQ 引发了类似解偶联的线粒体呼吸反应，该反应被 ANT 抑制剂羧基白术苷 (CATR) 部分减弱，支持了 ANT 在该基于鳃的模型中的功能参与。总之，这些发现提名 ANT 作为与 6PPDQ 诱导的急性呼吸道毒性相关的候选鳃线粒体靶标，并证明了化学蛋白质组学在优先考虑新兴污染物的机械相关蛋白质相互作用方面的实用性。

articles.title:
Human Gut Microbes
Transform the Chloroacetamide Herbicide
Metazachlor to Metabolites with Altered Toxicological Characteristics
articles.abstract: Abstract Metazachlor is a globally relevant chloroacetamide herbicide that undergoes microbial biotransformation in the environment, but its transformation by human gut microbiota has not been described. Here, we characterized metazachlor metabolism by human gut microbiota and assessed potential toxicological risks presented by its metabolites. Human fecal microbial communities exposed to metazachlor resulted in 5 known and 17 previously unreported metabolites of metazachlor being identified. Key metabolites were synthesized, and the resulting reference standards were used to confirm structures and elucidate the multistep biotransformation pathway. Cytotoxicity of key metabolites was characterized using human gastrointestinal cell lines, and two of the tested metabolites, namely the thiol of metazachlor M2 and the cysteamine disulfide M6, were more cytotoxic to these cells than metazachlor. Additionally, we confirmed that the thiol M2 had high Caco-2 monolayer permeability, similar to metazachlor. According to physiologically based kinetic modeling of blood concentrations, fast excretion of metazachlor and metabolite levels below cytotoxicity thresholds at the acceptable daily intake level of exposure were anticipated. These findings reveal that metazachlor is extensively metabolized by the human gut microbiota to metabolites with potentially altered biological effects, suggesting their consideration in evaluating human health risks due to metazachlor exposure.
articles.title_zh:
人类肠道微生物
改造氯乙酰胺除草剂
吡草胺到毒理学特性改变的代谢物
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 吡草胺是一种全球相关的氯乙酰胺除草剂，在环境中经历微生物生物转化，但其通过人类肠道微生物群的转化尚未被描述。在这里，我们表征了人类肠道微生物群的吡草胺代谢，并评估了其代谢物带来的潜在毒理学风险。暴露于吡草胺的人类粪便微生物群落导致鉴定出 5 种已知的吡草胺代谢物和 17 种以前未报告的吡草胺代谢物。合成了关键代谢物，并使用所得参考标准来确认结构并阐明多步生物转化途径。使用人胃肠道细胞系对关键代谢物的细胞毒性进行了表征，两种测试的代谢物，即吡草胺 M2 的硫醇和二硫化半胱胺 M6，对这些细胞的细胞毒性比吡草胺更强。此外，我们证实硫醇 M2 具有较高的 Caco-2 单层渗透性，与吡草胺类似。根据基于生理学的血液浓度动力学模型，预计在可接受的每日摄入暴露水平下，吡草胺和代谢物水平会快速排泄至低于细胞毒性阈值。这些研究结果表明，吡草胺被人类肠道微生物群广泛代谢为具有潜在改变生物效应的代谢物，这表明他们在评估吡草胺暴露造成的人类健康风险时应予以考虑。

articles.title:
Field-Constrained
Diurnal Viscosity Variability of
Urban PM2.5 and Implications for N2O5 Uptake across Global Megacities
articles.abstract: Abstract Aerosol phase state governs condensed-phase diffusion and heterogeneous reactivity, yet viscosity constraints for ambient urban PM2.5 remain scarce. Here, we quantified relative humidity (RH)-dependent viscosities of urban PM2.5 collected in Ansan, South Korea, during summer 2024 using a poke-and-flow technique coupled with fluid-dynamics simulations, yielding 6.2 × 104 to 1.3 × 107 Pa s at RH ∼20–40% and exceeding ∼108 Pa s at RH < ∼10%. Integrating the Ansan data set with previously reported PM2.5 viscosities from Seoul and Beijing, a unified temperature–RH parametrization was derived using the Vogel–Tammann–Fulcher framework and applied via a machine-learning surrogate to hourly meteorological data from 14 global megacities over September 2023–August 2024. Predicted PM2.5 viscosity was systematically lower at night than during the day across all cities, driven by RH-induced plasticization that outweighed nighttime cooling, although these predictions were based on 24 h PM2.5 composition and therefore did not include time-resolved changes in aerosol chemical composition. Incorporating viscosity-dependent N2O5 diffusivity into a resistor-model framework yielded mean nighttime N2O5 uptake coefficients of approximately 0.01–0.07, up to approximately 1 order of magnitude below the conventional liquid-particle assumption of 0.1, though substantial uncertainty remains from propagated viscosity measurement errors and parametrization assumptions. These results suggest that viscosity measurements from field-collected PM2.5 can provide improved estimates of diurnal aerosol-phase conditions relevant to nocturnal N2O5 reactivity and nitrate formation in urban atmospheres.
articles.title_zh:
场约束
粘度日变化
城市 PM2.5 以及对全球大城市 N2O5 吸收的影响
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 气溶胶相态控制着凝聚相扩散和非均相反应性，但对周围城市 PM2.5 的粘度约束仍然很少。在这里，我们使用刺流技术与流体动力学模拟相结合，对 2024 年夏季在韩国安山收集的城市 PM2.5 的相对湿度 (RH) 依赖性粘度进行了量化，在 RH ∼20–40% 时产生 6.2 × 104 至 1.3 × 107 Pa s，在 RH < 20% 时超过 ∼108 Pa s。 ～10%。将安山数据集与之前报告的首尔和北京 PM2.5 粘度相结合，使用 Vogel-Tammann-Fulcher 框架得出统一的温度-相对湿度参数化，并通过机器学习替代方法应用于 2023 年 9 月至 2024 年 8 月全球 14 个大城市的每小时气象数据。在相对湿度诱导的驱动下，所有城市的预测 PM2.5 粘度在夜间系统性地低于白天尽管这些预测是基于 24 小时 PM2.5 成分，因此不包括气溶胶化学成分的时间分辨变化，但塑化作用超过了夜间冷却。将粘度相关的 N2O5 扩散率纳入电阻模型框架中，得到的平均夜间 N2O5 吸收系数约为 0.01-0.07，比传统液体粒子假设 0.1 低约 1 个数量级，尽管传播的粘度测量误差和参数化假设仍然存在很大的不确定性。这些结果表明，通过现场收集的 PM2.5 进行粘度测量可以更好地估计与城市大气中夜间 N2O5 反应性和硝酸盐形成相关的昼间气溶胶相条件。

articles.title:
Decoupling the Roles
of Oxygen-Containing Functional
Groups and Aromatic Carbon Clusters in the Reduction of Halogenated
Contaminants on Carbon-Based Cathodes
articles.abstract: Abstract While carbon-based cathodes are widely used to mediate the electrochemical reduction of contaminants, the structural properties governing their rapid electron transfer remain poorly understood. Here, we decouple the roles of bulk conductivity and surface reactivity by quantifying the size of aromatic clusters and oxygen functional groups (OFGs) in biomass-derived cathodes. We demonstrate fundamental governing principles using tetrabromobenzene as the probe pollutant. We find that while increasing pyrolysis temperature drives the growth of aromatic clusters and increases dehalogenation performance (e.g., plateauing at 850 °C with a cluster size of ∼14 aromatic rings), these conductive networks are inert in the absence of OFGs. Introducing OFGs onto these clusters increases electron transfer efficiency by 50–85%, whereas selectively reducing these groups decreases activity by up to 75%. The optimized cathodes exhibit capacities that surpass those of commercial activated carbon and rival those of carbon black, providing a rational blueprint for designing high-efficiency carbon electrodes and enabling improved performance across a range of applications.
articles.title_zh:
角色解耦
含氧官能团
卤化物还原中的基团和芳香碳簇
碳基阴极上的污染物
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 虽然碳基阴极被广泛用于介导污染物的电化学还原，但控制其快速电子转移的结构特性仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们通过量化生物质衍生的阴极中芳香族簇和氧官能团（OFG）的大小来解耦体电导率和表面反应性的作用。我们使用四溴苯作为探针污染物展示了基本的控制原理。我们发现，虽然提高热解温度会促进芳香族簇的生长并提高脱卤性能（例如，在 850°C 时达到稳定温度，簇大小为~14 个芳香环），但这些导电网络在没有 OFG 的情况下是惰性的。将 OFG 引入这些簇中可将电子转移效率提高 50-85%，而选择性减少这些基团可将活性降低高达 75%。优化的阴极表现出超越商业活性炭并与炭黑相媲美的容量，为设计高效碳电极并提高一系列应用的性能提供了合理的蓝图。

and Microscopic
Investigation of U(VI) and Eu(III) Adsorption on Carbonaceous Nanofibers”

articles.title:
Probabilistic Assessment
of PM2.5 and Ozone
Co-Occurring Extremes under Wildfire Smoke in the Contiguous United
States
articles.abstract: Abstract Wildfire smoke has become a significant cause of extreme air quality events across the United States. However, its role in the joint occurrence of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and ozone extremes remains poorly understood. Most prior studies examined the two pollutants separately, even though there is growing evidence that co-occurrence may increase health risks. In this study, we developed a probabilistic spatiotemporal framework to quantify the risk of PM2.5-ozone co-occurring extremes under the influence of wildfire smoke across the contiguous United States from 2004 to 2023. The spatiotemporal Bayesian neural field (ST-BayesNF) model integrates satellite products on smoke coverage, ground measurements of PM2.5 and ozone, and meteorological reanalysis to estimate daily probabilities of co-occurring extremes at a spatial resolution of 5 km. Using a neural field, the model can explicitly capture nonlinear covariate effects, complex spatial dependence, and temporal evolution, as well as providing uncertainty quantification. Model assessments demonstrate that the ST-BayesNF model is able to differentiate coextreme from noncoextreme days and that the model has strong sensitivity to smoke density and its interaction with boundary layer height and near-surface temperature. Predictive results show a significant increase in co-occurrence risk during smoke events, and such amplified risks emerge not only in the western US but increasingly in the Midwest and Northeast due to long-range smoke transport. The ST-BayesNF model provides a probabilistic, spatiotemporally explicit approach for characterizing increased compound extremes under a changing fire regime.
articles.title_zh:
概率评估
PM2.5 和臭氧
邻近美国野火烟雾下同时发生的极端事件
州
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 野火烟雾已成为美国极端空气质量事件的重要原因。然而，人们对其在细颗粒物 (PM2.5) 和臭氧极端事件联合发生中的作用仍知之甚少。尽管越来越多的证据表明同时出现可能会增加健康风险，但大多数先前的研究都是单独检查这两种污染物。在这项研究中，我们开发了一个概率时空框架，以量化 2004 年至 2023 年美国本土野火烟雾影响下 PM2.5 与臭氧同时发生极端事件的风险。时空贝叶斯神经场 (ST-BayesNF) 模型集成了烟雾覆盖卫星产品、PM2.5 和臭氧地面测量以及气象再分析，以估计每日发生极端事件的概率。空间分辨率为 5 公里的同时出现的极端情况。使用神经场，该模型可以明确捕获非线性协变量效应、复杂的空间依赖性和时间演化，并提供不确定性量化。模型评估表明，ST-BayesNF 模型能够区分共极端天和非共极端天，并且该模型对烟雾密度及其与边界层高度和近地表温度的相互作用具有很强的敏感性。预测结果显示，烟雾事件期间共现风险显着增加，这种放大的风险不仅出现在美国西部，而且由于烟雾长距离输送，越来越多地出现在中西部和东北部。 ST-BayesNF 模型提供了一种概率性、时空显式方法，用于描述不断变化的火情下增加的复合极端情况。

articles.title:
Transdisciplinary
Approach to Private Well Research
articles.abstract: Abstract More than 60 million people in the United States and Canada rely on private drinking water systems (mostly private wells), which fall outside of national regulations for water quality and management. This decentralized infrastructure creates unique challenges. First, fragmented policy oversight leads to inconsistent data availability. Second, population heterogeneity in well users requires accounting for the social determinants of health and behavioral differences. Additionally, the individualized nature of well management creates persistent gaps between knowledge generation and the protective action. A broad goal of private well research is to (1) understand, predict, and prevent potential health problems related to well water consumption and (2) enable individual and collective action to reduce exposures to contaminants in well water. Here, we propose a conceptual model to advance private well research through a transdisciplinary approach that links water sources to health and prioritizes engagement among researchers, communities, and decision makers. We also identify challenges and opportunities aimed at improving data systems, refining hazard and risk assessments, linking interdisciplinary research and practical knowledge, and sustaining long-term partnerships. While our geographic focus is on North America, the principles and strategies outlined are globally relevant to addressing health risks associated with unregulated private drinking water sources.
articles.title_zh:
跨学科
私人油井研究方法
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 美国和加拿大有超过 6000 万人依赖私人饮用水系统（主要是私人水井），这些系统不符合国家水质和管理法规。这种去中心化的基础设施带来了独特的挑战。首先，分散的政策监督导致数据可用性不一致。其次，良好使用者的群体异质性需要考虑健康和行为差异的社会决定因素。此外，油井管理的个性化性质在知识生成和保护行动之间造成了持续的差距。私人水井研究的一个广泛目标是（1）了解、预测和预防与井水消耗相关的潜在健康问题；（2）使个人和集体行动能够减少井水中污染物的暴露。在这里，我们提出了一个概念模型，通过跨学科方法推进私人水井研究，将水源与健康联系起来，并优先考虑研究人员、社区和决策者的参与。我们还确定了旨在改进数据系统、完善危害和风险评估、将跨学科研究和实践知识联系起来以及维持长期合作伙伴关系的挑战和机遇。虽然我们的地理重点是北美，但概述的原则和战略在全球范围内都适用于解决与不受监管的私人饮用水源相关的健康风险。

articles.title:
Interplay
of Morphology and Polymer Composition Drives
Estuarine Fate and Food Web Distribution of Nanoplastics: Evidence
from a Multitrophic Mesocosm Using Upconversion Nanoparticle Tracers
articles.abstract: Abstract Current ecological risk assessments often rely on spherical reference particles, potentially misrepresenting the behavior of abundant fibrous nanoplastics. Using upconversion nanoparticle (UCNP) labeling and inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS), we quantified the fate of size-matched spherical polystyrene (PS) and fibrous polyacrylonitrile (PAN) nanoplastics in an estuarine mesocosm. Distinct particle attributes─driven by the synergistic interplay of geometric morphology and polymer intrinsic density─altered environmental partitioning: spherical PS exhibited repeated settling–resuspension cycling, whereas fibrous PAN rapidly accumulated in surface sediments (94% aqueous removal within 12 h). This physical divergence shifted bioaccumulation patterns across trophic levels. Lower trophic organisms (Zostera asiatica, Crassostrea gigas, Rapana venosa) accumulated PS in proportion to water-column availability. Conversely, the demersal fish Sebastes schlegelii exhibited higher burdens of fibrous PAN despite lower aqueous concentrations. Time-gated imaging revealed stronger PAN-associated signals in hepatic tissues, consistent with morphology-enhanced tissue retention in benthic vertebrates. These results indicate that spherical models may underestimate microfiber risks in benthic food webs, highlighting the need to incorporate shape-specific partitioning and retention factors into nanoplastics risk assessments.

形态学和聚合物成分驱动
纳米塑料的河口命运和食物网分布：证据
使用上转换纳米粒子示踪剂从多营养中宇宙中获取
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 当前的生态风险评估通常依赖于球形参考颗粒，这可能会歪曲丰富的纤维纳米塑料的行为。使用上转换纳米粒子（UCNP）标记和电感耦合等离子体质谱（ICP-MS），我们量化了尺寸匹配的球形聚苯乙烯（PS）和纤维状聚丙烯腈（PAN）纳米塑料在河口中生态系统中的命运。独特的颗粒属性（由几何形态和聚合物固有密度的协同相互作用驱动）改变了环境分配：球形 PS 表现出重复的沉降-再悬浮循环，而纤维状 PAN 在表面沉积物中迅速积累（12 小时内去除 94% 的水）。这种物理差异改变了营养级的生物累积模式。低营养生物（Zostera asiatica、Crassostrea gigas、Rapana venosa）积累的 PS 与水柱可用性成比例。相反，尽管水体浓度较低，底栖鱼类 Sebastes schlegelii 却表现出较高的纤维 PAN 负荷。时间选通成像揭示了肝组织中更强的 PAN 相关信号，这与底栖脊椎动物形态增强的组织保留一致。这些结果表明，球形模型可能低估了底栖食物网中的微纤维风险，突出表明需要将特定形状的分配和保留因素纳入纳米塑料风险评估中。

articles.title:
Future Directions
in Protein Affinity Selection–Mass
Spectrometry for High-Throughput Protein–Ligand Recognition
articles.abstract: Abstract The rapid proliferation of synthetic chemicals has far outpaced the ability of traditional toxicological methods, underscoring the urgent need for efficient strategies to identify bioactive contaminants. While previous approaches have contributed significantly to the discovery of bioactive chemicals, they remain limited by low efficiency and substantial operational complexity. To meet this challenge, protein affinity selection–mass spectrometry (AS-MS) uses proteins as molecular “baits” to selectively capture bioactive chemicals from environmental samples. Its integration with high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS) facilitates the high-throughput identification of bioactive chemicals. In this review, we summarize recent advances in AS-MS and highlight its unique strengths in uncovering novel protein targets, elucidating unexplained toxicological mechanisms, and identifying bioactive transformation products and endogenous ligands. We critically examine the key methodological bottlenecks that currently limit its broader application and propose targeted strategies to mitigate these challenges. Particular emphasis is placed on the role of machine learning (ML) in overcoming the hurdles of structural elucidation and direct transcriptional activity prediction. AS-MS integrated with ML-driven analytics holds substantial promise as a cornerstone platform for next-generation environmental bioactive chemical screening and regulatory prioritization.
articles.title_zh:
未来的方向
蛋白质亲和力选择-质量
高通量蛋白质-配体识别的光谱分析
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 合成化学品的快速扩散远远超过了传统毒理学方法的能力，这凸显了迫切需要有效的策略来识别生物活性污染物。虽然以前的方法对生物活性化学品的发现做出了重大贡献，但它们仍然受到效率低和操作复杂性的限制。为了应对这一挑战，蛋白质亲和选择质谱 (AS-MS) 使用蛋白质作为分子“诱饵”，选择性地从环境样品中捕获生物活性化学物质。其与高分辨率质谱 (HRMS) 的集成有助于生物活性化学物质的高通量鉴定。在这篇综述中，我们总结了 AS-MS 的最新进展，并强调了其在发现新的蛋白质靶点、阐明无法解释的毒理学机制以及识别生物活性转化产物和内源配体方面的独特优势。我们批判性地研究目前限制其更广泛应用的关键方法瓶颈，并提出有针对性的策略来缓解这些挑战。特别强调机器学习（ML）在克服结构阐明和直接转录活性预测方面的障碍的作用。 AS-MS 与 ML 驱动的分析相集成，作为下一代环境生物活性化学品筛选和监管优先级的基石平台，具有巨大的前景。

articles.title:
Matrix-Derived
Radium
Mobilization in Shallow Aquifers
Near Unconventional Oil and Gas Operations
articles.abstract: Abstract Previous studies in Pennsylvania identified localized “hotspots” of elevated salinity (Cl–, Ba2+, Sr2+) in shallow groundwater thought to be associated with unconventional oil and gas (UOG) operations. Because produced water generated during UOG operations is both highly saline and enriched in radium, accidental releases could increase groundwater salinity and radium activity. Elevated salinity from other sources such as road salt or septic tanks could also release radium from aquifer solids through cation exchange. Therefore, we measured combined radium activity (226+228Ra) in shallow groundwater (n = 91) and tested for associations with UOG wells, historical surface impoundments, or reported spills within 1, 3, or 5 km. All samples were below U.S. EPA maximum contaminant levels [0.185 Bq/L (5 pCi/L)] and consistent with regional background values. Radium activities were statistically greater within 3 km of spills and impoundments and correlated positively with the density of UOG wells within 3 km. Although radium correlated with Cl–, Ba2+, and Sr2+, other geochemical indicators, Na/Cl, Cl/Br, and 228/226Ra, indicate that radium was likely not directly derived from UOG fluids. Only six samples were consistent with produced water mixing with shallow groundwater. Instead, most of the salinity was primarily attributed to shallow sources that released matrix-bound radium.
articles.title_zh:
矩阵导出
镭
浅层含水层的动员
近非常规石油和天然气作业
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 宾夕法尼亚州先前的研究发现了浅层地下水中局部盐度升高（Cl–、Ba2+、Sr2+）的“热点”，这些“热点”被认为与非常规石油和天然气 (UOG) 作业有关。由于 UOG 作业期间产生的采出水含盐量高且富含镭，因此意外泄漏可能会增加地下水盐度和镭活性。来自其他来源（例如路盐或化粪池）的盐度升高也可能通过阳离子交换从含水层固体中释放镭。因此，我们测量了浅层地下水 (n = 91) 中的组合镭活度 (226+228Ra)，并测试了与 UOG 井、历史地表蓄水或报告的 1、3 或 5 公里内泄漏的关联。所有样品均低于美国 EPA 最大污染物水平 [0.185 Bq/L (5 pCi/L)]，并与区域背景值一致。统计上，镭活动在泄漏和蓄水的 3 公里范围内较高，并且与 3 公里范围内 UOG 井的密度呈正相关。尽管镭与 Cl–、Ba2+ 和 Sr2+ 相关，但其他地球化学指标 Na/Cl、Cl/Br 和 228/226Ra 表明镭可能不是直接源自 UOG 流体。只有六个样品符合采出水与浅层地下水的混合情况。相反，大部分盐度主要归因于释放基质结合镭的浅源。

articles.title:
A
Kinetic-Molecular
Framework for Resolving Electron-Donating
Moieties in Natural and Effluent Organic Matter
articles.abstract: Abstract The redox activity of dissolved organic matter (DOM) plays a critical role in natural and engineering aquatic systems. Although phenolic moieties are typically recognized as the dominant electron-donating moieties (EDM) in naturally occurring DOM (NOM), the chemical nature and reactivity of EDM in wastewater-derived DOM (EfOM), remain poorly understood. In this study, a kinetic categorizing framework was developed for resolving the composition of EDM within DOM by using the second-order rate constants for the reactions of the radical cation of 2,2′-azino-bis(3-ethylbenzothiazoline-6-sulfonic acid) (ABTS•+) (kapp, ABTS•+) with DOM isolates and a suite of model electron-donating compounds. Our results reveal that NOM contains a larger fraction of rapidly reacting ABTS•+ reducible components with kapp, ABTS•+ > 1 × 103 M–1 s–1, accounting for more than 50% of the total EDM. In contrast, EDM in EfOM mainly consist of antioxidants with relatively low redox activity (kapp, ABTS•+ < 10 M–1 s–1), accounting for 70% of the total EDM. Combining kinetic categorization and Fourier transform ion cyclotron resonance mass spectrometry analysis, the results suggest that EDM in EfOM are associated with nitrogen- and/or sulfur-containing heteroatom compounds. This novel method has important implications for understanding the aquatic redox chemistry of DOM and developing source-adaptive water oxidative treatment strategies in engineering systems.
articles.title_zh:
一个
动力学分子
解决电子供给问题的框架
天然和废水有机物中的部分
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 溶解有机物（DOM）的氧化还原活性在自然和工程水生系统中起着至关重要的作用。尽管酚类部分通常被认为是天然存在的 DOM (NOM) 中主要的给电子部分 (EDM)，但废水衍生的 DOM (EfOM) 中 EDM 的化学性质和反应性仍然知之甚少。在本研究中，通过使用 2,2'-azino-bis(3-乙基苯并噻唑啉-6-磺酸) (ABTS•+) (kapp, ABTS•+) 自由基阳离子与 DOM 分离物和一组模型给电子化合物反应的二阶速率常数，开发了一个动力学分类框架，用于解析 DOM 中 EDM 的组成。我们的结果表明，NOM 含有较大比例的快速反应 ABTS•+ 可还原组分，且具有 kapp，ABTS•+ > 1。 1×103 M–1 s–1，占EDM总量的50%以上。相比之下，EfOM中的EDM主要由氧化还原活性相对较低的抗氧化剂组成（kapp，ABTS•+<10 M–1 s–1），占总EDM的70%。结合动力学分类和傅里叶变换离子回旋共振质谱分析，结果表明 EfOM 中的 EDM 与含氮和/或含硫杂原子化合物有关。这种新方法对于理解 DOM 的水生氧化还原化学和在工程系统中开发源适应性水氧化处理策略具有重要意义。

articles.title:
Comparable Organic
Aerosol Mass Enhancement during
Photochemical and Dark Oxidation of Biomass Burning Emissions
articles.abstract: Abstract Secondary organic aerosol (SOA) formed from wildfire/biomass-burning emissions (BB) represents a significant fraction of global SOA production. However, there are large uncertainties in representing BB-SOA in climate models. We studied the evolution of organic aerosols (OA) from burning three biomass samples─savannah grass, savannah wood, and boreal forest surface─under different combustion conditions and during daytime (photochemical oxidation) and nighttime (dark oxidation) aging in an atmospheric chamber. OA dominated the BB emissions by contributing ∼82–99% of the total PM1 mass. Atmospheric aging by both oxidation processes produced comparable amounts of net OA mass. We show, with PMF analysis, that this is connected to the more efficient loss of primary OA, which compensates for the more efficient gas-phase oxidation during daytime aging compared with nighttime. The observed moderate OA mass enhancement (0.75–1.3 times) agrees well with field observations, thereby addressing the discrepancy between laboratory and field studies. For both aging scenarios, total OA emission factors after aging are similar to those of primary OA, providing new insights into the evolution of BB emissions. Our results suggest a simplified treatment of OA in climate models in remote areas with low NOx concentrations.
articles.title_zh:
可比有机
期间气溶胶质量增强
生物质燃烧排放物的光化学和暗氧化
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 由野火/生物质燃烧排放 (BB) 形成的二次有机气溶胶 (SOA) 占全球 SOA 产量的很大一部分。然而，在气候模型中表示 BB-SOA 存在很大的不确定性。我们研究了在不同燃烧条件下以及在大气室中白天（光化学氧化）和夜间（暗氧化）老化过程中燃烧三种生物质样品（热带草原草、热带草原木材和北方森林表面）时产生的有机气溶胶 (OA) 的演变。 OA 在 BB 排放中占主导地位，占 PM1 总质量的 82-99%。两种氧化过程的大气老化产生的净 OA 质量相当。我们通过 PMF 分析表明，这与初级 OA 更有效的损失有关，与夜间相比，初级 OA 可以补偿白天老化期间更有效的气相氧化。观察到的中度 OA 质量增强（0.75-1.3 倍）与现场观察结果非常吻合，从而解决了实验室和现场研究之间的差异。对于这两种老化情景，老化后的总 OA 排放因子与初级 OA 的排放因子相似，为 BB 排放的演变提供了新的见解。我们的结果表明，在氮氧化物浓度较低的偏远地区，可以简化气候模型中的 OA 处理。
